title: How the elastic axis folds the transonic flutter boundary: shock energy transfer and conformally calibrated active learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.23298v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Isogai's case A, a pitch-plunge aerofoil whose elastic axis lies half a chord ahead of the leading edge, has a folded transonic flutter boundary in inviscid flow: near the bottom of the transonic dip several flutter speeds coexist at one Mach number. We map this boundary, and the family obtained by moving the elastic axis, with coupled unsteady Euler simulations, a Gaussian-process surrogate of the damping coefficient trained by batch active learning, and split conformal prediction on independent random simulations, which turns the surrogate into stability calls with a distribution-free error rate. Three failure modes of time-domain damping labels that leave no trace in the residuals are documented, and the half-degree mean incidence left by the common one-degree start is shown to raise the flutter speed at the dip by 2.8%, more than any numerical setting. With 80 simulations the learned case A boundary labels 64 of 65 independent runs

translated_title: 弹性轴如何折叠跨声速颤振边界：激波能量传递与共形校准的主动学习
translated_abstract: Isogai A工况是一个俯仰-沉浮耦合翼型，其弹性轴位于前缘前方半弦长处，在无粘流动中呈现出折叠的跨声速颤振边界：在跨声速凹谷底部附近，同一个马赫数下存在多个共存的颤振速度。我们通过耦合的非定常Euler模拟、由批量主动学习训练的阻尼系数高斯过程代理模型，以及在独立随机模拟上进行的分裂共形预测，绘制了这一边界以及移动弹性轴所得到的边界族；共形预测使代理模型在进行稳定性判定时具有与分布无关的误差率保证。文中记录了时域阻尼标签的三种在残差中不留任何痕迹的失效模式，并证明常用的1度初始迎角所遗留的0.5度平均迎角会使凹谷处的颤振速度提高2.8%，其影响超过任何数值参数设置。仅用80次模拟，学习得到的A工况边界即可对65个独立算例中的64个完成正确标注。
tldr: 本文通过批量主动学习训练的高斯过程代理模型结合分裂共形预测校准，仅用80次非定常Euler模拟便绘制出Isogai A工况翼型折叠的跨声速颤振边界，揭示了弹性轴位置与激波能量传递对边界折叠的作用机制，并发现时域阻尼标签的隐性失效模式及初始迎角残余对颤振速度的显著影响。
en_tdlr: Using a batch active learning Gaussian-process surrogate calibrated by split conformal prediction, this work maps the folded transonic flutter boundary of Isogai's case A aerofoil with only 80 unsteady Euler simulations, revealing how elastic-axis position, shock energy transfer, and hidden failure modes of time-domain damping labels shape the boundary.
